featured_reviews.name: Mr Dattatraya
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Is with reference to Mr Vikas Goswami & Ms Kiran Yadav who are the Apollo Pharmacy Shop representatives.
When I visited the Medical With Doctor prescription from Fortis Hospital with a 3 Days course, they issued me a 5 days course tablet saying that we cannot give the cutting piece of medicine when I objected to them they asked me to bring original hardcopy prescription where I was showing them the soft copy in phone, they asked the hardcopy only when I objected them that I want only 3 days tablet then I came back to home which approx 300m from Shop took the hardcopy and went to medical shop then they asked me to carry the xerox copy, then I asked a very simple question that when you were issuing the 5 days tablet you don't wanted the hardcopy and when I demanded the 3 days tablet you want the Hardcopy can you please help me understand the science behind this, then they said while issuing cutting medical antibiotics piece we have to maintain record that makes it very clear that if you issue 5 days of antibiotics you don't have to maintain the record but when you have to issue 3 days antibiotics medical you have to maintain the record, then I demanded them that please show me the record that you have maintained for issuing the antibiotics till date because if it's matter of public health safety then you have maintained the record but they don't have any of the hospital slip they are completely nil.

With this I went to the police sitting place and verbally complained to them this is the case they called Mr Vikas Goswami and then he apologized for his act.

Since this is a matter of grave concern for me as a common man as I'm an educated person then I realised what would the poor people with less education visit this shop then the question arises.

1. This case is clear care of public harassment by making them run in the name of hard paper copy whereas today we are going digitally in every field.
2. They are putting the public health at risk if the rule book says that you have to maintain the record of the hospital slip while issuing the antibiotics as they don't have the record.
3. If a poor person with pain came to medical with slip asking the medicine if they don't give it in loose numbers then he has to pay the full amount though the doctor neither suggested and he has to give the hard earned money making the debt burden poor more and more pressurized to pay.
4. The most important point is that I can see the zero representation of a Marathi person when I visited the shop and when I and the police both spoke to them both of them were speaking only Hindi.
5. For the record there is a CCTV Installed at the Medical for the record.

With all this  I want a clear printed paper notification to be sticked at medical stating that we issue the loose medicine as per the prescription of doctors.

If they don't stick to this notification by 6:00 pm I have left with no option but to visit the Bhandup police station and lodge an official written police complaint against Mr Vikas Goswami, Ms Kiran Yadav and Apollo Pharmacy because the instruction are clearly from the management of Apollo Pharmacy.
